sections.h2: Why regular mowing suits Queanbeyan's mix of blocks
paras: The older streets of Queanbeyan and Karabar have established gardens where kikuyu and couch lawns put on serious growth from September, and Crestwood, built through the 1970s and 80s, is much the same. Jerrabomberra was developed from the 1990s with larger family blocks, where a big lawn that gets away takes several cuts to bring back.

Googong is the other end of the scale, a new estate from the 2010s onward with small blocks and newly laid lawns that need careful establishment mowing, cut high and only once the turf has rooted. Regular lawn mowing Queanbeyan wide means we know which block needs which approach.

The Queanbeyan River runs through town and cold air settles along it, so hard frosts from May to August stop most lawns growing and we drop to a monthly tidy through winter. From September the spring surge arrives and our lawn mowing Queanbeyan runs move to fortnightly.

Autumn brings leaf drop from the deciduous street trees in the older streets, and we rake, mow and remove it with the clippings. In summer we cut higher and less often so the lawn holds moisture, with water restrictions in mind.

faqs.q: Do you cover Jerrabomberra and Googong as well as Queanbeyan?
faqs.a: Yes. Our lawn mowing Queanbeyan runs cover Queanbeyan, Karabar, Crestwood, Jerrabomberra, Googong and Beard. Nature strips are included unless you ask us to leave them, and we edge along the kerb and footpath so the frontage looks finished.

faqs.q: Can you mow a new lawn in Googong?
faqs.a: Yes. Newly laid turf needs establishment mowing: waiting until it has rooted, cutting high and removing only a little each time. We check the lawn before the first cut and bring it down gradually as it settles in.

faqs.q: How much does mowing cost in Queanbeyan?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the block, the state of the lawn and what else is included, so we quote each lawn mowing Queanbeyan job individually. Quotes are free and upfront, and we will not guess a price without seeing the block.

faqs.q: Do you take the grass clippings and green waste away?
faqs.a: Yes, every time. Green waste is removed after every mowing visit, and after garden maintenance and clean-ups too. Being just over the border makes no difference, we load it and take it away with us.
